player1 := [8, 6, 9, 5, 10, 7]
player2 := [7, 8, 6, 9, 8, 8]

p1_total := player1.sum()
p2_total := player2.sum()

print "Player 1 total: " + string(p1_total)
print "Player 2 total: " + string(p2_total)

winner := (p1_total > p2_total) ? "Player 1" : "Player 2"
print "Winner: " + winner

p1_8 := player1.where(_ >= 8).len
p2_8 := player2.where(_ >= 8).len

print "P1 rounds 8+: " + string(p1_8)
print "P2 rounds 8+: " + string(p2_8)

player1 := [8, 6, 9, 5, 10, 7]
player2 := [7, 8, 6, 9, 8, 8]

p1_total := player1.sum()
p2_total := player2.sum()

p1_eights := player1.where(_ >= 8).len
p2_eights := player2.where(_ >= 8).len

winner := p1_total > p2_total ? "Player 1" : (p2_total > p1_total ? "Player 2" : "Tie")

print "Player 1 total: " + string(p1_total)
print "Player 2 total: " + string(p2_total)
print "Winner: " + winner
print "P1 rounds 8+: " + string(p1_eights)
print "P2 rounds 8+: " + string(p2_eights)

temps := [22, 18, 25, 31, 29, 17, 24, 28, 20, 26]
count := temps.len
avg := temps.sum() / count
hot := temps.where(_ >= 28).len
mild := temps.where(_ >= 20 and _ < 28).len
cold := temps.where(_ < 20).len

assert(hot + mild + cold == count)
assert(avg == 24)

print "Days measured: " + string(count)
print "Average: " + string(avg)
print "Hot days (28+): " + string(hot)
print "Mild days: " + string(mild)
print "Cold days (<20): " + string(cold)

temps := [22, 18, 25, 31, 29, 17, 24, 28, 20, 26]
total_days := temps.len
sum_temps := temps.sum()
avg := sum_temps / total_days

hot_days := temps.where(_ >= 28).len
mild_days := temps.where((_ >= 20) and (_ < 28)).len
cold_days := temps.where(_ < 20).len

assert(hot_days + mild_days + cold_days == total_days)
assert(avg == 24)

print "Days measured: " + string(total_days)
print "Average: " + string(avg)
print "Hot days (28+): " + string(hot_days)
print "Mild days: " + string(mild_days)
print "Cold days (<20): " + string(cold_days)
